title: Repaired mixed-unit profit-and-loss scaling
points: Pipeline normalization now treats extracted unit labels containing both `thousands` and `millions` as thousands while preserving the raw ambiguity warning for audit visibility.
Rebuilt and published profit-and-loss statements, ratios, and quality flags after correcting ASL March and June 2024 P&L rows that had been affected by inconsistent mixed-unit scaling.
Production quality flags now show one open unit-or-scale ratio warning, down from three, with ASL and BGL removed from that user-facing warning class.
